title: Set the meta tags a link preview reads
description: Seventeen nodes that exist because the runtime writes no `<meta>` tags for you: a `JavaScriptFunction` reaches `document.head` and sets title, description, canonical URL, robots, the Open Graph set and the Twitter card, each fed from its own `String` or `States` node so a page can override one without restating the rest. The `Expression` defaulting the URL to `location.href` is what stops a forgotten `og:url` pointing at the wrong page. ⚠️ Nothing here needs a node that does not exist — but nothing here is done for you either, so budget the seventeen nodes.
